## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -2.55% | 1M: +1.04%) and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -11.25%) → flat, while XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) give mixed confirmations.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Volatility muted: VXX (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -11.25%) BELOW TREND → flat; Credit mixed: HYG (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND indicating neutral-to-slightly cautious credit tone.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -0.81%) → flat and SPY CORRECTION (1W: -2.55% | 1M: +1.04%) show mixed stocks-vs-bonds pressure; dollar and curve flagged as neutral in the barometer.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Healthcare leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) and XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) while Tech cooling: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%). Style: Value/cyclicals showing relative strength vs Growth momentum softening.

**5. US vs Global?**
US lagging short-term but holding: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -2.55% | 1M: +1.04%) vs EM weakness — EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -1.26%) and China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -6.75%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation cooling: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -20.95%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -2.63%) while IWM in CORRECTION (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +0.66%) — small-cap risk appetite softening.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Mixed commodities: CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +3.21%) with base/industrial metals showing resilience while Gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -7.97%) and Silver SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -13.99%) underperform.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed-to-strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) but Brent BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -3.32%) — traders should monitor oil vs equity energy divergence; Natural gas UNG in CORRECTION (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +6.46%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLV and XLE both 1W/1M positive (ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: XLK, SOXX, IGV and SPY show 1W vs 1M mismatch (CORRECTION) — this is a MAJOR divergence that supports a restrained NEUTRAL stance.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) and XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) as areas showing strength; reduce exposure to highly speculative ETFs like IBIT (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -20.95%) and tech momentum exposures while monitoring credit signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) and Healthcare XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%). BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) and Communication sector ETFs which are lagging.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial CPER (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +3.21%) if 1M strength holds. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -7.97%) and precious-metals ETFs SLV (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -13.99%) remain weak.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), watch XLK 1M support and SPY short-term 1M trend break for regime tilt.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, mixed signals from volatility, credit and sector leadership. XLE and XLV showing relative strength while XLK and speculative crypto ETFs show major divergences to monitor.
